name: io.github.nk3750/jitapi
description: Point Claude at any API from its OpenAPI spec. JitAPI semantically searches the right endpoints and resolves their dependencies so the model calls them in the right order — no API key required (local embeddings by default).

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Voyage AI API key for higher-quality cloud embeddings. JitAPI works without any key using local fastembed embeddings.
environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. OpenAI API key for cloud embeddings (alternative to Voyage).
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Cohere API key for cloud embeddings (alternative to Voyage).
environmentVariables.name: COHERE_API_KEY
